title: Keyed Box Collector
prompt:
Implement a collector over boxes that can contain rewards, keys, and references to child boxes.

`Box(id, candies, keys, children)` stores a box ID, a nonnegative reward count, iterable keys, and iterable child box IDs. Implement `get_max_candies(boxes, initially_open, key_to_box) -> int`. `boxes` is the complete catalog, `initially_open` contains root box IDs that are both discovered and unlocked, and `key_to_box` maps a key to the ID it unlocks.

A catalog box can open exactly once only after it is both discovered and unlocked. Opening it collects its candies, reveals its keys, and discovers its child IDs. A key may unlock a catalog box before that box is discovered; it must wait until a parent reveals it. Repeated child references, duplicate keys, cycles, and self-references must not collect a box twice. A key absent from `key_to_box`, or one mapped to a box outside the catalog, has no effect. Do not mutate the supplied boxes or build a user interface.

example.reasoning: Opening the root both unlocks and reveals the side box, so each reward is collected once.
